you make with borrowed money is a trade.
You're trading your future time and
freedom for something you want right
now. And in almost every case, it's a
terrible deal. The worst thing you can
do with your money is spend money you
don't have. But the best thing you can
do with your money is recognize that
trap and choose a different path. Your
future self will thank you. Your stress
levels will improve. And you might just
discover that happiness doesn't come
from the stuff you own, but from the
freedom that comes from not owing money
for stuff you don't even want anymore.
